steps.name: preserve-first-pass-libgcc
argv:
set -eu
set -- /toolchain/usr/lib/gcc/{target}/*/libgcc.a
[ "$#" -eq 1 ] && [ -f "$1" ] || exit 1
/usr/bin/nm --defined-only "$1" > /work/first-pass-libgcc.symbols
for symbol in _Unwind_Resume _Unwind_RaiseException _Unwind_DeleteException; do
  grep -E " [TW] $symbol$" /work/first-pass-libgcc.symbols >/dev/null || exit 1
done
cp -p "$1" /work/first-pass-libgcc.a
sha256sum /work/first-pass-libgcc.a | cut -d' ' -f1 > /work/first-pass-libgcc.sha256

steps.name: restore-first-pass-libgcc
argv:
set -eu
set -- /toolchain/usr/lib/gcc/{target}/*/libgcc.a
[ "$#" -eq 1 ] && [ -f "$1" ] || exit 1
cp -p /work/first-pass-libgcc.a "$1"
expected=$(cat /work/first-pass-libgcc.sha256)
actual=$(sha256sum "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1)
[ "$actual" = "$expected" ] || exit 1
/usr/bin/nm --defined-only "$1" > /work/installed-libgcc.symbols
for symbol in _Unwind_Resume _Unwind_RaiseException _Unwind_DeleteException; do
  grep -E " [TW] $symbol$" /work/installed-libgcc.symbols >/dev/null || exit 1
done
